title: Korean Kicked British Tofu Welsh Rarebit
description: A vegan twist on the classic Welsh rarebit, featuring marinated tofu and spicy kimchi, served on a crispy tava-griddle bread
instructions: Preheat the tava-griddle or a large skillet over medium heat
In a shallow dish, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil for the tofu marinade
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and let it sit for at least 10 minutes
In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and cook the marinated tofu until golden brown
In a blender or food processor, blend the kimchi, nutritional yeast, and a pinch of salt and pepper until coarsely chopped
Add the blended kimchi mixture to the cooked tofu and stir to combine
Butter the tava-griddle bread slices on one side
Place the bread slices, buttered side down, on the preheated tava-griddle
Spoon the tofu and kimchi mixture over the bread slices
Dissolve the vegan beef stock cubes in 1/4 cup of hot water and spoon the mixture over the tofu
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the bread is crispy and the filling is heated through
